dsh-navigation-bar 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。钢琴键风格会话内导航条：一根键锚定一条用户消息，悬停显示消息预览气泡与阶梯展开，点击平滑跳转。

posts.en:
dsh-navigation-bar is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Piano-key in-conversation navigation for the Web UI: one key per user message with hover ladder, message-preview tooltip, and active-message highlight; click to smooth-scroll.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-aaaf56877bcffbc3f399.html
